name: Butte Aviation

summary: Montana Part 61 flight school whose cost article works from a single $195 flight hour.
differentiator: Works its cost example from a single $195 flight hour, so the $7,800 minimum is easy to check, but the article does not say what the $195 includes.
pricing: Flight time at $195 an hour in its cost article; 40 hours is $7,800.

aircraft.label: Flight hour, as used in its cost examples (what it includes is not stated)

dualHourStated.note: The article prices flight time at $195 an hour and does not split aircraft from instructor.

estimate.hoursBasis: 40 hours at $195 an hour, the Part 61 minimum
estimate.note: The article says most students need more than the minimum.

bestFor: Students in western Montana who want a rule-of-thumb figure.
skipIf: You want a rate sheet; this is a blog article, not a price list.
watchOut: A cost article, not a rate sheet.
$195 an hour is not split into aircraft and instructor.
